CustomField.description: Whether this chain was built with allowRestart() and may be restarted from step 1 from the Chain Monitor. Declared by the chain author at build time; never edited by hand.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Checked when the chain author declared this chain safe to restart from step 1. The Chain Monitor offers its restart action only for checked runs. Managed automatically; shown for diagnostics.
CustomField.label: Allow Restart
